place.name: Aragua
place.description: Aragua (Spanish pronunciation: [aˈɾaɣwa]), officially the Aragua State (Spanish: Estado Aragua), is one of the 23 states of Venezuela. It lies in the north-central Central administrative region and is bordered by the Caribbean Sea to the north, Miranda and La Guaira to the east, Guárico to the south, and Carabobo to the west.
